BUDGET HOTEL BECOMES A PORT FOR FOREIGNERS TO PROSTITUTE

The Malaysian Immigration Department (JIM) conducted an operation on August 23, 2026, at three locations around Seremban, Negeri Sembilan.

Seven local residents were detained for allegedly engaging in immoral activities and espionage, while other foreigners were detained for allegedly engaging in activities.

The investigation found that the activities were carried out by placing foreign women at hostels or budget hotels on a daily or weekly basis. These hostels were believed to be managed and controlled by local and foreign citizens who acted as 'captains' or managers. The foreign women were believed to offer sex services for a fee of RM50 per service to customers. The operation is believed to have been operating for about a year, with a structured management structure in place to ensure the operation continued and was estimated to generate a profit of around RM540,000 per year.

🚧👮🏻‍♂ DBKL GEMPUR 6 PREMIS HIBURAN DI KEPONG, SEPUTEH & BUKIT BINTANG

Pada 23 Ogos 2026 (Ahad), Dewan Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur (DBKL) telah melaksanakan tindakan khas terhadap premis-premis hiburan di sekitar parlimen Kepong, Seputeh dan Bukit Bintang, susulan operasi yang dijalankan pada malam 22 Ogos 2026 (Sabtu).

Tindakan ini menyasarkan premis yang dikendalikan oleh warga asing, gagal mematuhi syarat lesen petempatan makanan, serta beroperasi tanpa lesen sah untuk mengadakan hiburan.

Hasil daripada operasi ini, sebanyak 8 notis tawaran kompaun dikeluarkan di bawah Akta Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan 1974, UUK Pelesenan Tred, Perniagaan dan Perindustrian (WPKL) 2016, UUK Pelesenan Petempatan Makanan (WPKL) 2016 dan UUK Iklan (WP) 1982.

3 Notis Pemberitahuan Tentang Kesalahan turut dikeluarkan terhadap premis yang mengadakan hiburan tanpa lesen. Selain itu, 3 sitaan barangan berkaitan hiburan serta 1 penutupan premis dilaksanakan serta-merta.

Menurut kenyataan MetMalaysia, daripada jumlah itu, 11 kawasan adalah di Semenanjung membabitkan  Larut dan Matang, Kuala Kangsar, Kampar serta Batang Padang di Perak; Kuala Krai di Kelantan; Kuantan, Raub, Temerloh dan Pekan di Pahang; serta Hulu Selangor dan Gombak di Selangor.

Sementara itu, lima kawasan di Sabah yang turut berada pada Tahap 1 ialah Telupid, Tenom, Sandakan, Pitas dan Beluran, manakala kawasan yang direkodkan di Sarawak melibatkan daerah Marudi.

MetMalaysia memaklumkan status Tahap 1 itu dikeluarkan apabila suhu maksimum harian di sesuatu kawasan mencecah 35 hingga 37 darjah Celsius untuk sekurang-kurangnya tiga hari berturut-turut.
